name: analyzr
description: Analyzr — evaluate any Python file and get a detailed report on quality, style, complexity, and library-specific issues.

analyzr.maxLineLength.description: Maximum allowed line length (PEP8 default is 79, Black default is 88).

analyzr.checks.whitespace.description: Check for trailing whitespace and blank line issues.

analyzr.checks.docstrings.description: Check for missing or malformed docstrings on functions and classes.

analyzr.checks.imports.description: Check for unused imports, wildcard imports, and ordering.

analyzr.checks.typeAnnotations.description: Check for missing type annotations on function arguments and return types.

analyzr.checks.libraryRules.description: Apply library-specific best-practice rules (pandas, numpy, requests, etc.).

analyzr.checks.security.description: Run bandit security checks (requires bandit to be installed).

analyzr.maxComplexity.description: Functions with cyclomatic complexity above this value are flagged.
